services.name: Hunting & Fishing
services.desc: Hunting and fishing in the Northwest Territories is regulated by the Territorial Government, with specific regulations in place for different areas. While hunting is generally prohibited within territorial parks to ensure visitor safety and protect wildlife and ecosystems, there are many other areas in the region where these activities can be enjoyed responsibly. Fishing is typically allowed in most parks unless otherwise stated, provided territorial regulations are followed. Make sure to research and familiarize yourself with the specific guidelines for the area you plan to visit.
